tasks.title: Lock catalog order submission while the request is in flight
tasks.acceptance: Repeated clicks cannot create duplicate orders.
tasks.evidence: The catalog product dialog no longer submits an order at all — its submit handler only calls addLine() into the local cart (js/app.js, js/cart.js), so there is nothing left to double-fire there. The one remaining order-creation request is the cart checkout, in the #checkout-button click handler in js/app.js: it disables the button and swaps its label before the request, and restores both only on failure, so a repeated click cannot create a duplicate order set. Covered by tests/order-submit-resilience.test.js (source contract) and confirmed passing 2026-08-04; a later independent Tester rerun should confirm before this is treated as fully closed against the live UI.
